Anant sinh ki beti shivangi sinh ki shadi men shahi intjamon ke bich ghora res ka bhi aayojan kiya gaya hai. is res men jitne vale ghurasvar ko inam men mahindra thar di jaegi, jiski charcha shadi samaroh men khub ho rahi hai. mokama men anant sinh ki beti ki shadi ko lekar taiyariyan, mehmanon aur khas intjamon ki charcha lagatar surkhiyon men hai.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
